srcA = from(bucket: "BucketMonitoring")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "anydesk" and r["_field"] == "anydesk_id")

srcB = from(bucket: "monitoring")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "pc" and r["metric"] == "anydesk" and r["_field"] == "anydesk_id")

union(tables: [srcA, srcB])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: r._value })) 
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "anydesk_id"})

// Source 1 : Nouveau Bucket
src1 = from(bucket: "BucketMonitoring")
  |> range(start: -6h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "system") 
  |> last()
  |> group() 
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: r.company })) 
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

// Source 2 : Ancien Bucket
src2 = from(bucket: "monitoring")
  |> range(start: -6h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "pc")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: r.company }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

// Fusion
union(tables: [src1, src2])
  |> group() 
  |> distinct(column: "_value")
  |> limit(n: 1)

data = from(bucket: "BucketMonitoring")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r["_measurement"] == "diskio" and
    r["_field"] == "read_bytes_sec"
  )

top5 = data
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> group(columns: ["host", "device"])
  |> mean()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> keep(columns: ["host", "device"])

join(tables: {d: data, t: top5}, on: ["host", "device"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with display_name: r.host + " - " + r.device }))
  
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time", "host"], columnKey: ["display_name"], valueColumn: "_value")

// Source A : Nouveau Bucket
srcA = from(bucket: "BucketMonitoring")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "cpu" and r["_field"] == "cpu_percent")

// Source B : Ancien Bucket
srcB = from(bucket: "monitoring")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "pc" and r["metric"] == "cpu" and r["_field"] == "cpu_percent")

// Fusion
union(tables: [srcA, srcB])
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "host"]) // On regroupe pour fusionner les points au même timestamp
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

// Source A
srcA = from(bucket: "BucketMonitoring")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "network")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "bytes_recv" or r["_field"] == "bytes_sent")

// Source B (Structure différente avec metric="network")
srcB = from(bucket: "monitoring")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "pc" and r["metric"] == "network")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "bytes_recv" or r["_field"] == "bytes_sent")

union(tables: [srcA, srcB])
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "host"]) // On regroupe pour fusionner les points au même timestamp
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

data = from(bucket: "BucketMonitoring")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r["_measurement"] == "diskio" and
    r["_field"] == "write_bytes_sec"
  )

top5 = data
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> group(columns: ["host", "device"])
  |> mean()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> keep(columns: ["host", "device"])

join(tables: {d: data, t: top5}, on: ["host", "device"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with display_name: r.host + " - " + r.device }))
  
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time", "host"], columnKey: ["display_name"], valueColumn: "_value")

srcA = from(bucket: "BucketMonitoring")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "memory" and r["_field"] == "memory_percent")

srcB = from(bucket: "monitoring")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "pc" and r["metric"] == "memory" and r["_field"] == "memory_percent")

union(tables: [srcA, srcB])
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "host"]) // On regroupe pour fusionner les points au même timestamp
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

srcA = from(bucket: "BucketMonitoring")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "disk" and r["_field"] == "percent")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with disk_name: r.mountpoint })) 

srcB = from(bucket: "monitoring")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "pc" and r["metric"] == "disk" and (r["_field"] == "disk_percent" or r["_field"] == "percent"))
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with disk_name: r.disk })) // Normalisation nom

union(tables: [srcA, srcB])
  |> group(columns: ["disk_name", "host"]) 
  |> last() // Garde uniquement la mesure la plus fraîche pour ce disque précis
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "disk_name", "host"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)

srcA = from(bucket: "BucketMonitoring")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "system" and r["_field"] == "uptime_minutes")

srcB = from(bucket: "monitoring")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "pc" and r["_field"] == "uptime_minutes")

union(tables: [srcA, srcB])
  // 1. On force le regroupement par champ pour fusionner les deux sources
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "host"]) 
  // 2. On prend la valeur la plus récente parmi les deux buckets
  |> last()
  // 3. On dégroupe pour l'affichage dans Grafana
  |> group()

srcA = from(bucket: "BucketMonitoring")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "updates" and r["_field"] == "pending_updates")

srcB = from(bucket: "monitoring")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "pc" and r["_field"] == "pending_updates")

union(tables: [srcA, srcB])
  // 1. On force le regroupement par champ pour fusionner les deux sources
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "host"]) 
  // 2. On prend la valeur la plus récente parmi les deux buckets
  |> last()
  // 3. On dégroupe pour l'affichage dans Grafana
  |> group()

srcA = from(bucket: "BucketMonitoring")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "memory" and r["_field"] == "memory_total")

srcB = from(bucket: "monitoring")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "pc" and r["_field"] == "memory_total")

union(tables: [srcA, srcB])
  // 1. On force le regroupement par champ pour fusionner les deux sources
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "host"]) 
  // 2. On prend la valeur la plus récente parmi les deux buckets
  |> last()

  |> group()

// Source 1 : Nouveau Bucket (BucketMonitoring)
srcA = from(bucket: "BucketMonitoring")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "disk" and r["_field"] == "total")
  |> last()
  // CORRECTION ICI : On utilise "mountpoint" au lieu de "device" pour avoir C:
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with logical_name: r.mountpoint })) 

// Source 2 : Ancien Bucket (monitoring)
srcB = from(bucket: "monitoring")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "pc" and r["metric"] == "disk" and r["_field"] == "total")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with logical_name: r.disk })) 

// Fusion
union(tables: [srcA, srcB])
  |> group(columns: ["logical_name"]) 
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "logical_name"])
  // On laisse groupé pour que Grafana affiche bien une valeur par disque

list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"

// Récupère les hosts du bucket 1 filtrés par la variable company
v1 = schema.tagValues(
  bucket: "BucketMonitoring", 
  tag: "host", 
  predicate: (r) => r.company =~ /^${company:regex}$/
)

// Récupère les hosts du bucket 2 filtrés par la variable company
v2 = schema.tagValues(
  bucket: "monitoring", 
  tag: "host", 
  predicate: (r) => r.company =~ /^${company:regex}$/
)

union(tables: [v1, v2])
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
  |> distinct()
  |> sort()
